entities.summary: Meena Khadikar is an Indian Marathi and Hindi playback singer and composer. She is the second eldest daughter of Pandit Deenanath Mangeshkar and sister of singers Lata Mangeshkar, Asha Bhosle, Usha Mangeshkar and Hridaynath Mangeshkar.
